difficulty_reason: For a first order thickening of algebraic spaces over a base, the lemma shows that the defining universal property is equivalent to testing the lifting condition on test objects that are schemes, and further equivalent to testing only on affine schemes. The proof descends from an arbitrary test object to a covering by schemes and then to affine pieces, using the uniqueness in the universal property to glue the resulting lifts. Reducing the test class to affine schemes is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2979-3001.
